div.head: V As 1
div.ab: [Be ðon (þe) oþres monnes man underfehþ.] [Ld] ⁊ se ðe oþres monnes man underfó, ðe he for his yfele him from dó, ⁊ him [gesteoran] ne mæge his yfeles, gylde hine ðæm þe he ær folgode, ⁊ gesylle þam cynge CXX scll.

[Of taking into service another's man.] And he who takes into his service one who has been in the service of another, whom the latter has dismissed, because of his evil conduct, and because he has not been able to restrain him from evil doing, shall pay compensation for him, to the man in whose service he has been, and give 120 shillings to the king.

Be ðon oþres monnes man underfehþ. And se ðe oþres mannes man underfó, ðe he for his yfle him from dó, ⁊ him gesteoran ne mæge his yfles, gilde hine ðæm ðe he ær folgode, ⁊ gesylle ðæm cyng CXX scill.
